enrichment.core_claim: Auto Induced Cognitive Trance is a teachable nonpsychedelic altered state showing promise clinically and as an adjunct to psychedelic therapy.
enrichment.ask_question: How do patients learn to self-induce trance, and how long does training take?
enrichment.challenge_question: Beyond clinician case reports, are there controlled trials showing AICT outperforms placebo or standard care?
